stratum_definitions.accepted_prediction: All predictions with place_status_predicted=depicted; all included.
stratum_definitions.candidate_ungeocoded: Candidates exist, but none has a geolocation.
stratum_definitions.geocoded_level_unclassified: A geolocation exists, but no candidate has a classifiable geographic level and scores.
stratum_definitions.threshold_met_but_not_deployable: A model level threshold is crossed, but that level did not pass outer-CV deployment criteria.
stratum_definitions.near_threshold: Best eligible deployable score is within 0.10 below its level threshold.
stratum_definitions.mid_threshold: Best eligible deployable score is 0.10 to 0.30 below its level threshold.
stratum_definitions.far_threshold: Best eligible deployable score is more than 0.30 below its level threshold.

weighting_note: Strata are sampled at different rates. Use population_by_stratum / sample_by_stratum as the design weight when estimating aggregate rates.
